guide.title: How to get your Steam API key
guide.intro: To read your library and playtime, Steam requires a key for its Web API. You generate it yourself, from your own account, in under a minute.
guide.step1: Open the official Steam page for API keys (the link is below).
guide.step2: Sign in with your Steam account, if you are not signed in already.
guide.step3: Enter a domain name: «localhost» is fine for local use. Then accept the Steam Web API terms of use.
guide.step4: Copy the key Steam generates and paste it into the field below.
guide.note: The key is personal and stays valid until you revoke it from Steam. Arcadium stores it encrypted and uses it only to read your library and playtime.
